title: 2.7 Pillars of Climate Resilient Green Economy of Ethiopia
description: Ethiopia’s CRGE strategy, its four pillars, renewable energy, forests and energy-efficient technology. Medium level.

options: Agriculture

options: By limiting expansion of land under cultivation

They raise pastoralist incomes while limiting emissions
